The '''raid above Bonadan''' was a [[Hit-and-hype raiding|hit and run]] attack on an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] commerce area in the [[Bonadan system/Legends|Bonadan system]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Xwing" />

The Bonadan system was under Imperial control during the early years of Galactic Civil War and thus was the site of a commerce site where several [[Class-A cargo container|cargo containers]] were being prepped by a couple of [[CT-11 space tug|space tugs]]. A couple of [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] such as ''[[Banthar]]'' and ''[[Deddite]]'' were on their way to pick up the containers. However the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], seeking ways to undermine the Empire's efforts to control star systems, sent two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] to destroy the defenceless cargo area before Imperial military forces could intervene.<ref name="Xwing" />

The Y-wings wasted no time and attacked the containers, using [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]] to save time. They also destroyed a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class]] shuttle called [[Krayt (shuttle)|''Krayt'']] that was carrying [[inspector]]s. By the time the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Enforcer (EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate)|''Enforcer'']] arrived, it was too late, as significant damage had been inflicted, and the Y-wings retreated to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].<ref name="Xwing" />

The successful hit and run mission was recreated as the first training exercise for pilots to use the Y-wing.<ref name="Xwing" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] as the first Y-wing historical mission, "Commerce Raid."<ref name="Xwing" />
